reasons: It is a one-line description with no logic that could fail.

terms.meaning: a folder of Python code that other code can import from by name

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Test suite description
sections.what: A one-line description saying this folder is the root of the test suite. It does nothing when the program runs.
sections.why: Likely reason: it documents the folder and marks it as importable.

summary: Marks the tests folder as a package so test files can share helper code.
purpose: Declares the root of the test suite. It has one line of description and no test logic.
why: Likely reason: it lets test files import shared helpers from the tests folder, such as the stub client and sample run context.
how: Nothing runs from this file. Python reads it when a test imports something under the tests folder or when pytest collects tests.
risks: Removing it could break imports between test files in some setups.
debug: If a test cannot import a helper from the tests folder, check that this file still exists.
